values.eml_summary: Reverse paths agree with each other (latent JS ≈ 10⁻⁵) but both land ≈ 0.011–0.015 from the true chart-A coordinate, above the 0.01 gate, for every family and at every scale tested.
values.eml_summary_zh: 反向路徑彼此一致（潛在 JS ≈ 10⁻⁵），但兩者都落在離真正 chart-A 座標 ≈ 0.011–0.015 處，高於 0.01 門檻，所有家族、所有測試規模皆然。
values.eml_interpretation: Path coherence is not enough for atlas closure; the bias is the object v0.12–v0.13 then tried to explain.
